class.name: OcgGeomCartesianpoint
class.brief_description: Describes a point in 3D space. A Geom_CartesianPoint is defined by a gp_Pnt point, with its three Cartesian coordinates X, Y and Z.
class.description: ! Describes a point in 3D space. A ! Geom_CartesianPoint is defined by a gp_Pnt point, ! with its three Cartesian coordinates X, Y and Z.

method.name: from_1
method.description: Returns a transient copy of P.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Constructs a point defined by its three Cartesian coordinates X, Y and Z.

method.name: SetCoord
method.description: Assigns the coordinates X, Y and Z to this point.

method.name: SetPnt
method.description: Set <me> to P.X(), P.Y(), P.Z() coordinates.

method.name: SetX
method.description: Changes the X coordinate of me.

method.name: SetY
method.description: Changes the Y coordinate of me.

method.name: SetZ
method.description: Changes the Z coordinate of me.

method.name: Pnt
method.description: Returns a non transient cartesian point with the same coordinates as <me>.

method.name: Transform
method.description: Applies the transformation T to this point.

method.name: Copy
method.description: Creates a new object which is a copy of this point.
